reason: The patch adds `int order();` to CryptoProvider with no default body (common/src/main/java/org/keycloak/common/crypto/CryptoProvider.java:44), and CryptoIntegration.java:57 sorts with `Comparator.comparingInt(CryptoProvider::order)`. Only the four providers in this repository implement order(), so any outside implementation stops compiling, and an already-compiled one throws AbstractMethodError when it is sorted.
